name: 项目合同关联查询
description: 实现项目与合同的双向关联查询
statement: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.contract_amount, c.contract_status FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 合同主表 c ON p.project_no = c.project_no
sql: SELECT p.project_no, p.project_name, c.contract_no, c.contract_name, c.contract_amount, c.contract_status FROM 项目主表 p LEFT JOIN 合同主表 c ON p.project_no = c.project_no
